hints.title: Binary Columnar Addition
hints.text: Adding binary numbers from right to left follows base-two addition where one plus one equals two, producing digit zero and carry one.

hints.title: Bit Sum Modulo Invariant
hints.text: At each bit position, the sum of both bits plus carry modulo two gives the current bit, while the sum integer divided by two gives the next carry.

hints.title: Two Pointer Base Two Accumulation Procedure
hints.text: Set pointers to the ends of strings a and b. While either pointer is valid or carry is non-zero, sum the bits and carry. Append sum modulo two to the output list and update carry to sum divided by two. Reverse the resulting list and join to form the final binary string.

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(max(N, M)) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting binary strings to built-in integers triggers overflow on binary strings exceeding standard bit widths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating columnar addition processes digits in O(max(N, M)) time using only O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output string.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle inputs of varying lengths cleanly and remember to process any remaining carry at the end.
